parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both files serve the domain's order/stock concern. DomainError.ts defines a single error hierarchy: the abstract DomainError carries a 'kind' discriminator, and the concrete errors (ValidationError, NotFoundError, InsufficientStockError, InvalidTransitionError) each set a fixed kind. StockReservationService.ts uses the module's abstractions consistently. It throws the shared NotFoundError instead of an ad-hoc error. It delegates the stock check to Product.assertCanReserve and the stock change to Product.reserve/release, so the stock invariant stays in Product and is not repeated in the service. It merges lines via OrderLine.consolidate and accesses products only through ProductRepository. Its own all-or-nothing rule is enforced in one place, inside reserve(). No split concerns, duplicated invariants or bypassed abstractions were found.
